title: Pivot LES SL Drop Bar Review: Taking Gravel to the Extreme
content:
Slapping drop bars onto a carbon hardtail might look like a parts-bin compromise, but for ultra-endurance routes and steep singletrack, 100mm of travel makes perfect sense.

Read the full article at Pivot LES SL Drop Bar Review: Taking Gravel to the Extreme on Velo.
